mostWorthwhile.text: Testing and correcting the curved line was worthwhile: it connected unequal motor speeds to a practical trim adjustment.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the pen-lift lever before the straight-line test was frustrating because the missing prerequisite was unclear.

surprise.text: I expected to fit the pen lift after trimming, but the rover first needed another remote test.

arbitrary.text: The requirement to test the straight line before fitting the pen lift felt somewhat arbitrary; its purpose was not clear until inspection revealed the remote as the next partner.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: diagnosing the curve and seeing the correction work made the construction feel useful, though I would hope for clearer prerequisites.
